markdown:
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 235 **Requirements** You have at least one hand free. The target can't be more than one size larger than you. --- You push a creature away from you. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check against your target's Fortitude DC. **Critical Success** You [push](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) your target up to 10 feet away from you. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
**Success** You push your target back 5 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
**Critical Failure** You lose your balance, fall, and land [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).
